usage: Load the fixed R04 page and wait for innerLip.ready / native final frame, then inject this classic IIFE script.
setMode(mode) selects baseline, no-local, or no-closure but does not update geometry or render. Run the existing native pose/update and capture a real frame.

visibleSamples(points,width,height) reads the current actual v.mesh after its real frame; points accept {x,y,label} or [x,y], at most 256. Input is zero-based framebuffer pixel indices with top-left origin, sampled at x+.5/y+.5. The synchronous result may be awaited.

restore() restores the original solver.apply descriptor and invokes one original viewer.update if an ablation has executed. The current declared pose is retained; caller must verify the restored actual frame.
intervention: Only the original display position array of the original lip solver is restored at verified instance-level stage boundaries.
no-local restores before-local positions at pairs.map entry; downstream closure, envelope, normal, strain and micro code then execute normally.
no-closure restores after-local positions at lips[Symbol.iterator] entry; closure pressure fields are deliberately preserved, making this a position-only causal ablation.

Every call restores pairs.map and lips iterator own-property descriptors in finally. Baseline/restore removes the outer solver.apply own hook and restores its original descriptor. Native exceptions mark failure and unhook.
No prototype, canonical positions, DNA, authored settings, shader source, workflow or published R04 file is modified.
attributionChecks: Actual drawing buffer dimensions and viewport/scissor are checked.
Actual draw and displayed vertex count and position buffer identity must match.

Original topology count is 198406 in the retained R04 evidence; final display count is 266098. Native sample mapping therefore requires exact fRest/csType/l19Oral correspondence for the full retained topology prefix. IDs appended beyond that prefix receive no invented sample.

Triangles come from the actual current index buffer, material groups and drawRange. CPU code performs homogeneous frustum clipping, front/back-side culling, screen-centre barycentric inclusion, frontmost NDC depth selection, and perspective-correct native attribute interpolation.
Unhit pixels return per-point available:false; failures of prerequisites return available:false with a reason. They do not throw into the parent frame runner.

MSAA edges within one pixel, depth ties and unsupported material coverage/depth behavior are explicitly flagged. Other scene objects and shader fragment discard/displacement are not reproduced; fragmentOwnershipCertain is always false.

checks: no-local removes local position delta only
no-closure removes closure position delta only
inner method descriptors restore after each call
restore returns outer descriptor and original native rebuild
synthetic native exception restores hooks and records failure

remainingCallerGate: Actual fixed R04 browser and CI rendering, real before/ablation/restored frames, declared pose and full native state invariants, and independent image review.
